inputs.name: Diagnostic EmberBSD kernel from the earlier input test

scenario: Check pointer input in a physical Plasma Wayland session. After a kernel update and reboot, check the HDMI mode, compositor renderer and pointer enumeration.
expected: The physical monitor shows Plasma with active PowerVR composition. Mouse movement changes the visible cursor position.
observed: With kernel a6f1c5c36, the operator confirmed visible cursor movement from the Logitech receiver. The receiver used ums and wsmouse. After reboot with cd33561f8, KWin reported HDMI-A-1 with active OpenGL ES 3.1 composition through Zink on PowerVR B-Series BXM-4-64 MC1. KWin listed wsmouse0. DRM and DE reported zero fault at the status check.
limits: The board revision is unknown. The DTB hash identifies the installed file used for both boots.
The kernel revisions and image hash identify diagnostic builds. The direct pointer check and the post-reboot status check cover separate boots.
Separate KMS tests encountered intermittent RCQ and TV0 retirement timeouts.
Hotplug, sustained operation and wider display and input coverage remain unqualified.
